facts.name: BlackRock
sentences: BlackRock's shares moved 5% or more on 4 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 23 November 2026, when the stock rose 3.9%.
The stock is up 7.1% this year, and at $1,146.03 it sits 6.5% below its 52-week closing high of $1,226.31 from 11 November 2026.
$1,000 invested in BlackRock five years ago would be worth $1,231 today.
